title: Notes: Add due dates to checklist items and a Tasks view across notes
description:
Evernote tasks live inside notes with due dates, recurrence, reminders and flags, and a central Tasks view lists them all (https://help.evernote.com/hc/articles/1500003792141). In Notes a checklist item is a to-do block with no date, and reminders are one per note (lib/notes-reminders.ts). 'Send to Track' covers team work, but personal tasks have nowhere to live. First scope: a due date on to-do blocks (typed with a date picker or '@' shortcut), a 'Tasks' entry in the Notes sidebar listing open items from every note grouped by Overdue / Today / Upcoming / No date with a link back to the note, and reuse the reminder cron to notify on the due time.

Priority: high. Effort: M. Compared with Evernote.

title: Notes: Search text inside images and PDF attachments
description:
Evernote searches text inside images and PDFs and, since 11.32, auto-generated image captions (https://releasebot.io/updates/evernote); Bear Pro does OCR on images and PDFs (https://bear.app/faq/features-and-price-of-bear-pro/). Notes stores attachments (app/api/notes/[id]/files) but search only looks at title, text blocks and tags, so receipts and scans imported from ENEX never show up. First scope: on upload (and for ENEX resources on import), extract PDF text and run OCR on images in a background job, store the text per attachment, include it in notes search and Ask your notes, and show 'Found in attachment' in the result.

Priority: high. Effort: M. Compared with Evernote.

title: Notes: Save searches with operators as smart lists in the sidebar
description:
Evernote has saved searches and Apple Notes has Smart Folders filtered by tags, checklists and dates (https://support.apple.com/guide/notes/use-smart-folders-apd58edc7964/mac). Notes already parses tag:, notebook:, intitle:, created:, updated: and todo: (lib/notes-query.ts) but a query is lost when you clear the box. First scope: a 'Save search' action next to the search field that stores name + query per user, lists saved searches in the sidebar under Tags, keeps them in sync with renames of tags and notebooks, and opens them with Cmd+K.

Priority: medium. Effort: S. Compared with Evernote.

title: Notes: Export a notebook or all notes as a Markdown or ENEX zip
description:
Evernote exports notebooks as ENEX or HTML from desktop, Apple Notes exports PDF and Markdown, and Bear exports many formats (https://bear.app/faq/export-your-notes/). Notes exports one note at a time to Markdown (app/api/notes/[id]/export). People moving years of notes in want to know they can get them out the same way. First scope: 'Export notebook' in the notebook menu and 'Export all notes' in Notes settings, returning a zip with one .md per note (front matter with tags, created, updated, source_url), attachments in a folder, and an optional .enex file so the export round-trips into Evernote.

Priority: medium. Effort: S. Compared with Evernote.

title: Notes: Group notebooks into stacks
description:
Evernote groups notebooks into stacks, and an ENEX import of a long-time user brings dozens of notebooks. Notes has a flat notebook list in the sidebar (components/notes/NotesApp.tsx), so after importing 30 notebooks the sidebar is a long scroll. First scope: a stack (or one level of parent notebook) that notebooks can be dragged into, collapsible in the sidebar, with 'notebook:' search matching a stack name to include all its notebooks, and keep the stack name when importing ENEX files that carry it.

Priority: medium. Effort: S. Compared with Evernote.

title: Notes: Create notes from templates
description:
Evernote offers templates when you create a note (meeting, journal, trip) and made template creation easier in 11.31 (https://releasebot.io/updates/evernote). Docs already has built-in and workspace templates (lib/docs-templates.ts), but Notes always starts empty. First scope: a template picker on the 'New note' split button with a few personal templates (meeting, daily log, reading notes), 'Save as template' from any note, and templates that preset tags and notebook.

Priority: medium. Effort: S. Compared with Evernote.

title: Notes: Select several notes to move, tag, pin or trash them at once
description:
Evernote added multi-select bulk actions on mobile in 2025 (https://evernote.com/blog/2025-recap) and has them on desktop. The Notes list only acts on one note at a time (row menu in components/notes/RowMenu.tsx), which makes cleaning up an ENEX import slow. First scope: Shift/Cmd-click and checkbox selection in the list, a bar with Move to notebook, Add tag, Pin, Trash and Export, keyboard support (Shift+Arrow to extend, Esc to clear) and one undo toast for the batch.

Priority: medium. Effort: S. Compared with Evernote.

title: Notes: Record audio in a note and transcribe it
description:
Evernote records audio with pause/resume and transcribes it with speaker recognition (https://evernote.com/blog/2025-recap, https://releasebot.io/updates/evernote); Apple Notes records and transcribes too (https://support.apple.com/guide/notes/record-and-transcribe-audio-apdb5106e334/mac). Notes has file blocks (10 MB cap) but no recorder and no transcription. First scope: a 'Record' block that uses MediaRecorder in the browser, uploads the audio as an attachment, and, when AI is set up, adds a transcript below it that is searchable and used by Ask your notes.

Priority: low. Effort: M. Compared with Evernote.

title: Notes: Create a note linked to a Cal booking or event
description:
Evernote's calendar pop-up creates a note linked to a Google or Outlook event (December 2025, https://evernote.com/blog/2025-recap). Our Cal app has bookings with attendees, but there is no way to open a meeting note from them. First scope: a 'Meeting note' action on a Cal booking that creates a note titled with the event and date, with attendees and a link back, and lists linked notes on the booking.

Priority: low. Effort: S. Compared with Evernote.
